implemented: GateExecutionRequest, GateExecutionResult, GateRunnerRegistry, deterministic GateRunner, VerificationExecutor
GateRunV2-to-EvidenceV2 conversion from terminal GateExecutionResult values
Scheduler enforcement for normal node gates, explicit gate_verification nodes, and goal_verification nodes
Dynamic fixture migration from host-authored final Evidence to GateRunner-produced GateRun/Evidence
Schema and example records for gate execution request/result/report
Metrics for gate_execution_integrity, unrun_gate_pass_count, GateRun count by status and level, and lineage validity
not_implemented: Generic ahra goal CLI; reserved for TASK-0038
Unified Scheduler execution for repair PlanIR; reserved for TASK-0036
Capability Admission redesign; reserved for TASK-0034
Production LLM verifier; explicitly out of TASK-0033 scope

object_boundaries.selection: VerificationSelection remains pure and does not produce GateRun/Evidence.
object_boundaries.execution: VerificationExecutor resolves a GateRunner and records one terminal GateRun/Evidence pair for each executed gate attempt.
object_boundaries.reuse: Reused Evidence remains in VerificationSelection.reusedEvidenceRefs and is not counted as a new GateRun.
object_boundaries.scheduler: NodeRun success now requires all declared required gates to pass through VerificationExecutor.
object_boundaries.goal_completion: Goal verification runs the declared L2 gate and also requires CompletionGateResult.complete.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Every selected required Gate produces exactly one terminal GateRun per attempt or a structured execution failure.
Every newly current Evidence record references the GateRun that produced it.
A failed, blocked, timed-out, malformed or missing GateRunner result prevents the owning NodeRun from succeeding.
A goal_verification node cannot pass when any required Claim lacks current passed Evidence produced by an executed Gate or validated reuse.
The dynamic fixture no longer constructs final passed Evidence directly in host code.
Tests distinguish selectedGateRefs, executedGateRunRefs and reusedEvidenceRefs.
L0, L1 and L2 Gate paths have at least one passing and one failing test.
Full local checks, schema lint and git diff checks pass.

known_limitations: GateRun/Evidence persistence remains in current in-memory/local report boundaries until TASK-0037.
Fixture repair execution still calls the executor directly after repair planning; TASK-0036 is responsible for routing repair PlanIR through the same Scheduler.
The deterministic GateRunner is sufficient for local executable verification and does not claim production agent verification coverage.
next_action: Independent EvidenceGate review for SG-5 executable-verification.
